claims.text: Reviewers widely report the cream effectively softens and heals very dry, rough, cracked, or scaly skin.
Many reviewers praise the value, noting it works as well as or is the same formula as pricier brand-name or prescription versions.
Several reviewers note the cream is thick and creamy rather than runny, and that this thicker formula works better for them.
Some reviewers highlight that it lacks the bad smell other brands have.
A few reviewers mention drawbacks: one experienced painful soreness, and another found the stiff tube hard to squeeze.
